sentences.en: This pair of lovers were carrying on an ardent correspondence.
sentences.zh: 这对情人正在进行热烈的情书往来。

sentences.en: Yuriko thoroughly enjoyed her occasional secret meetings with her lover.
sentences.zh: 由里子彻底享受着她偶尔的秘密会面与她的恋人。

sentences.en: She takes a new lover while he is in anguish.
sentences.zh: 她在他的痛苦中另寻新欢。
